units: pixels and seconds; image coords x right, y down, origin top-left of the 2560x1440 frame

camera.evidence: phase correlation vs empty background (frames 62-71): shift < 0.02 px in all tested frames; frames 64-71 identical to the background to within noise

objects.name: dragon
objects.description: single dark-grey winged dragon (bat-like wings, long tail, horns), the only moving object; flies right-to-left across the frame in front of the cliff, flapping, dipping twice toward the beach/water and leaving through the left edge
objects.reference_point: cx,cy = centroid of the silhouette mask (wings included). The Blender origin is not visible; it is near the body/pelvis, typically within ~30-60 px of the centroid; the centroid swings with the wingbeat (wings up -> centroid moves up). bbox_cx,bbox_cy also given.
objects.wingbeat: bbox height/area peak (wings raised) near frames 5 and 29-31, trough (wings level/down, silhouette flattest) near frames 13, 21-22 and 37; period ~24 frames (~1.0 s)

objects.name: dragon_shadow
objects.description: dark cast shadow of the dragon on the sand beach / shore rocks below it (e.g. frame 14 at x 1300-1650, y 1080-1150; frame 38 on the rocks x 550-800, y 1020-1190). Excluded from the dragon mask. Not tracked.

objects.name: dragon_reflection
objects.description: mirror reflection of the dragon in the water pool below the water line (y > ~1150-1200). Excluded from the dragon mask. Not tracked.

objects.name: cliff
objects.description: large white/brown eroded rock cliff filling the background; top edge from y~45 (x~2300) to y~360 (x~0); base meets the beach at y~880-1000 (x 1100-2560) and ~y 1100-1190 at the left behind shore rocks

objects.name: sky_and_distant_hills
objects.description: blue-grey sky and blurred grey hills at the top-left, y < ~380 at x=0 and y < ~60 at x~1700

objects.name: sand_beach
objects.description: pale sand/snow slope between cliff base and water, x ~900-2560, y ~880-1150

objects.name: water_pool
objects.description: shallow reflecting water across the bottom of the frame; first water row (water line used to cut reflections): (x,y) = (0,1200) (250,1200) (300,1192) (820,1192) (900,1150) (1500,1150) (1600,1160) (2560,1175); visual edge uncertain by ~30 px

objects.name: shore_rocks_left
objects.description: cluster of boulders at the left shore, x ~0-830, y ~1000-1200; the large dark boulder x~690-820, y~1050-1160; a tall pale rock spire at the far left x 0-140, y 850-1300

objects.name: dark_spot_on_sand
objects.description: small dark static patch on the sand at about (1960, 945), ~80x15 px; part of the background, not the dragon shadow
